entities.name: Ceiber Ávila
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ceiber David Ávila Segura is a Colombian boxer. He competed in the men's flyweight event at the 2016 Summer Olympics. In June 2021, he qualified to represent Colombia at the 2020 Summer Olympics. In the 2018 Central American and Caribbean Games, he won the gold medal.
